name: Figma to Code
summary: Figma plugin that turns a selection into editable HTML, React, Svelte, Tailwind, Flutter or SwiftUI code.
description: A deterministic Figma-to-code converter that runs inside Figma's plugin sandbox — no AI model, account, generation credits or design uploads. Select a frame, component or layer and generate readable HTML, React (JSX), Svelte, styled-components, Tailwind, Flutter or SwiftUI output, tune target-specific options like Tailwind token rounding, color variables and image embedding, then copy the code or download a Vite, Next.js, static HTML, Flutter or SwiftUI starter project.
contains: outputs HTML, React (JSX), Svelte, styled-components, Tailwind, Flutter and SwiftUI
runs in Figma Design and as a Dev Mode code generator
downloadable starters: Vite, Next.js, static HTML, Flutter, SwiftUI
no AI model, account or design uploads
free, no generation limits; warnings instead of silent guesses
